dogecoin.text:
@elonmusk @X @Tesla @dogecoin 5️⃣ Inflationary Nightmare – 5B new Doge printed yearly. That’s a never-ending sell wall. Imagine a sinking boat where you keep adding more water. 
💀 The Verdict:
✅ Doge will survive 🫡
❌ ATH again? A dream.
Holding Doge now is like waiting for Blockbuster to beat Netflix. 📼😂

@elonmusk @X @Tesla @dogecoin 3️⃣ Market Cap Reality 💰 – At $0.73, Doge was $100B+—bigger than some banks. Can it get there again? As likely as me becoming a billionaire overnight. 🥲

4️⃣ No Real Utility 🔧 – No smart contracts, no major adoption, just vibes and nostalgia. Doge is crypto’s pet rock. 🪨

@elonmusk @X @Tesla @dogecoin 1️⃣ Elon Factor 🚀 – If Musk integrates Doge into X/Tesla, it pumps. But betting on that is like waiting for your crush to text first—pure hopium. 😭

2️⃣ Retail FOMO 🤡 – New meme coins (PEPE, BONK) are stealing the spotlight. Doge is the grandpa at the meme party. 👴🐕
